name: Thornwood
description: A dry, wind-bent wood on the edge of the desert, far from any mountain you know.

clearing.name: Leaf-strewn Clearing
clearing.description: A small clearing in a wood of twisted, thorny trees. Dead leaves lie deep, and a bright, dry light slants down through the branches. A game trail leads east.

game_trail.name: Game Trail
game_trail.description: A narrow trail pressed into the leaf-litter by many small feet. East, the trees thin toward open light. A path runs south toward a low roof.

woodcutters_hut.name: Woodcutter's Hut
woodcutters_hut.description: A one-room hut with the door off its hinges. Whoever lived here left in a hurry, and some time ago.

wood_edge.name: Edge of the Wood
wood_edge.description: The thorn trees give out here, and the sand begins. A road of beaten earth runs east into the dunes.
